text: Some stance explanations on Compass were hard to read. They're fixed.
We found that some of McKinney's department names were inaccurate. They now come straight from the city.
Compass now shows more than 32,000 stances you can read. Our spreadsheet needed a bigger chair.
This week we also made progress on Civic Spaces and Focused Communities.
Portraits now carry the photo credit their licence asks for. Small print, done properly.
Ranking works on small phones & tablets now.
The explainer film is up on the home page.
Profile pages load a little faster.
A fix: one answer showed a position the person never took. It's gone.
Jackson and Boise got their own city banners.
Los Angeles now shows 23 unbroken years of city spending.
